name: Oracle of the Deep: Late-Night Data Seance
summary: Local data scientists pull strange signals from Saltlight's tide gauges and whale-song archive, then hand the room a notebook to find the next anomaly.
description: Local data scientists pull strange signals from Saltlight's tide gauges and whale-song archive, then hand the room a notebook to find the next anomaly. Laptops encouraged; pizza shaped like anglerfish provided.

name: Sunset Jazz on Pier Nine
summary: The Brass Barnacles quartet plays standards as the sun drops behind the moored sailboats.
description: The Brass Barnacles quartet plays standards as the sun drops behind the moored sailboats. Bring a blanket; the pier bar pours local cider.

name: Barnacle Bash Silent Disco
summary: Three headphone channels, three DJs, one echoing drydock.
description: Three headphone channels, three DJs, one echoing drydock. Switch between sea-punk, deep house and 2000s throwbacks until 2 a.m.

name: Kelp Forest Kayak Cleanup
summary: Paddle the kelp channels with A Marina's Mission volunteers, fishing out plastic and logging it for a debris-mapping project.
description: Paddle the kelp channels with A Marina's Mission volunteers, fishing out plastic and logging it for a debris-mapping project. Kayaks, gloves and snacks provided.

name: Saturday Seaside Market
summary: Over sixty stalls under striped awnings: dayboat fish on ice, flower bundles, pickled everything, hand-thrown pottery and a guy who sharpens knives while you wait.
description: Over sixty stalls under striped awnings: dayboat fish on ice, flower bundles, pickled everything, hand-thrown pottery and a guy who sharpens knives while you wait.

name: Seasick Standup at the Crow's Nest
summary: Saltlight's rowdiest comedy night: five comics, one host in a captain's hat, and a rule that every set must mention a fish.
description: Saltlight's rowdiest comedy night: five comics, one host in a captain's hat, and a rule that every set must mention a fish.

name: Lighthouse Laboratory Open House: VR Shipwreck Dive
summary: Put on a headset and explore a 1890s schooner wreck rebuilt from sonar scans, then try the AR tide-pool table.
description: Put on a headset and explore a 1890s schooner wreck rebuilt from sonar scans, then try the AR tide-pool table. Student XR projects demoed all afternoon.

name: Shipyard Robot Regatta
summary: Home-built autonomous boats race a buoy course across the basin.
description: Home-built autonomous boats race a buoy course across the basin. Watch from the seawall or enter your own bot in the open heat at 2 p.m.

name: Tidepool Walk with a Marine Biologist
summary: Low tide peaks at 2:40.
description: Low tide peaks at 2:40. Dr. Nia Okafor leads a slow scramble over the rocks to find sea stars, anemones and the occasional octopus.

name: Harbor Dumpling Brunch Crawl
summary: Four stops, four kinds of dumpling: crab soup dumplings, shrimp har gow, pierogi and a dessert bao.
description: Four stops, four kinds of dumpling: crab soup dumplings, shrimp har gow, pierogi and a dessert bao. Walking pace, ends at the market.
venueName: Meets at the Fish Box Clock

name: Paint the Lighthouse: Sip and Paint
summary: Canvas, brushes and a glass of wine; an instructor walks you through painting the Old Saltlight Lighthouse from the studio window.
description: Canvas, brushes and a glass of wine; an instructor walks you through painting the Old Saltlight Lighthouse from the studio window.

name: Saltlight Mariners vs. Port Coral FC
summary: The Mariners host their coastal rivals in the last home match of the season.
description: The Mariners host their coastal rivals in the last home match of the season. Supporters' section sings shanties the whole second half.

name: Sea Shanty Singalong at The Rusty Anchor
summary: Lyric sheets on every table, a fiddler and a concertina.
description: Lyric sheets on every table, a fiddler and a concertina. No experience needed, just volume.

name: Bioluminescence Night Paddle
summary: Glide through the marsh on a clear-bottom kayak while plankton light up every paddle stroke.
description: Glide through the marsh on a clear-bottom kayak while plankton light up every paddle stroke. Guided, beginner-friendly, limited to 12.

name: Sunday Beach Volleyball Open Play
summary: Show up, get put on a team.
description: Show up, get put on a team. Six courts, all levels, rotating every 20 minutes. Bring sunscreen.

name: Harbor Stories: Film Under the Stars
summary: A giant inflatable screen on the sand plays a classic ocean adventure.
description: A giant inflatable screen on the sand plays a classic ocean adventure. Popcorn cart and blankets; arrive early for the front rows.

name: Pop the Balloon: Harbor Speed-Friending
summary: New in town or just want more crew? Short rounds of conversation, then pop a balloon to reveal your next question.
description: New in town or just want more crew? Short rounds of conversation, then pop a balloon to reveal your next question. Mocktails included.

name: Sunday Makers' Swap Meet
summary: Trade old microcontrollers, 3D-printer filament, vintage radios and mystery cables.
description: Trade old microcontrollers, 3D-printer filament, vintage radios and mystery cables. Free soldering station for quick repairs.

name: Poetry by the Tide
summary: An open reading on the driftwood benches.
description: An open reading on the driftwood benches. Sign up for a five-minute slot or just listen to the waves and the verses.

name: AI for Good Roundtable
summary: Researchers and community organizers talk through using ML for flood forecasting and fisheries health, and where it goes wrong.
description: Researchers and community organizers talk through using ML for flood forecasting and fisheries health, and where it goes wrong. Q&A after.

name: Drag Brunch Ahoy!
summary: Mermaid-themed drag numbers, bottomless mimosas and a crab-cake benedict.
description: Mermaid-themed drag numbers, bottomless mimosas and a crab-cake benedict. Reservations fill up; tips go to the queer youth sailing club.

name: Boardwalk Pickleball Round-Robin
summary: Paddles provided, partners assigned.
description: Paddles provided, partners assigned. Fast games, a leaderboard, and lemonade for the winners.

name: Chess on the Boardwalk
summary: A dozen boards set up by the Saltlight Chess Club.
description: A dozen boards set up by the Saltlight Chess Club. Blitz, casual games or a lesson from a regular. Drop in any time.

name: Marina's Mission Health-Tech Meetup
summary: Clinicians from Saltlight General pitch real problems; builders pitch prototypes.
description: Clinicians from Saltlight General pitch real problems; builders pitch prototypes. Lightning demos, then a mixer with snacks.

name: Twenty Thousand Questions Under the Sea: Trivia
summary: Six rounds of trivia with an ocean-lore bonus round.
description: Six rounds of trivia with an ocean-lore bonus round. Teams of up to six; the winners' names get carved into the bar.

name: Beginner Arduino: Build a Tide Sensor
summary: Wire up an ultrasonic sensor and log real water levels from the dock.
description: Wire up an ultrasonic sensor and log real water levels from the dock. Kit included and yours to keep. No experience needed.

name: Moonlight Yoga on Lanternfall Beach
summary: A gentle flow on the sand under the rising moon.
description: A gentle flow on the sand under the rising moon. Mats available to borrow; ends with a guided breathing session to the sound of the surf.

name: Coral Reef Restoration Dive
summary: Certified divers help plant coral fragments on the Saltlight artificial reef.
description: Certified divers help plant coral fragments on the Saltlight artificial reef. Snorkelers can help from the surface. Gear rental included.

name: Karaoke Night at the Fish Box
summary: Main-stage karaoke with a light-up fish-crate stage.
description: Main-stage karaoke with a light-up fish-crate stage. Sea-song duets get a free round.

name: Tech Talk: Sonar, Signals and Machine Learning
summary: A lunch talk on teaching models to tell whales from ship noise.
description: A lunch talk on teaching models to tell whales from ship noise. Bring your lunch; slides and code shared afterward.

name: Chef's Table: Seven Courses of the Sea
summary: Chef Ines Marlow cooks seven courses from that morning's catch at a twelve-seat counter.
description: Chef Ines Marlow cooks seven courses from that morning's catch at a twelve-seat counter. Wine pairing optional.

name: Wednesday Night Sailing Races
summary: Watch from the breakwater or show up at the dock at 5 to crew for a skipper who needs hands.
description: Watch from the breakwater or show up at the dock at 5 to crew for a skipper who needs hands. No experience needed, just grippy shoes.

name: Open Mic at Driftwood Coffee
summary: Singer-songwriters, spoken word and the occasional ukulele.
description: Singer-songwriters, spoken word and the occasional ukulele. Sign-up sheet opens at 6:30.

name: Kids' Shipwright Workshop: Cardboard Boats
summary: Kids design and tape together a cardboard boat, then test it in the float tank.
description: Kids design and tape together a cardboard boat, then test it in the float tank. Ages 6-12 with a grown-up.

name: XR Art Night: Paint in Virtual Waves
summary: Sculpt glowing sea creatures in 3D with VR brushes and take home a video of your piece.
description: Sculpt glowing sea creatures in 3D with VR brushes and take home a video of your piece. Headsets provided.

name: Harbor Lights Art Walk
summary: Galleries along Barnacle Street stay open late with new shows, live painting and lantern-lit murals.
description: Galleries along Barnacle Street stay open late with new shows, live painting and lantern-lit murals. Start anywhere.

name: Oyster Shucking 101
summary: Learn to open, grade and slurp three local varieties.
description: Learn to open, grade and slurp three local varieties. Every student leaves with a shucking knife.

name: The Tempest at the Tidewater Playhouse
summary: Shakespeare's shipwreck comedy staged with real rigging and a water tank at the front of the stage.
description: Shakespeare's shipwreck comedy staged with real rigging and a water tank at the front of the stage. The first two rows may get wet.

name: Deep House at the Deep End
summary: Resident DJs play underwater-themed deep house under a ceiling of blue light.
description: Resident DJs play underwater-themed deep house under a ceiling of blue light. Doors at 10, peak around 1.

name: Hardware Hack Night
summary: Open bench night: oscilloscopes, soldering irons and a laser cutter, with mentors on hand.
description: Open bench night: oscilloscopes, soldering irons and a laser cutter, with mentors on hand. Bring a half-finished project and some ambition.

name: Friday Fish Fry and Bluegrass
summary: Fried catfish, hushpuppies and slaw, with the Heron Creek Pickers on the porch stage.
description: Fried catfish, hushpuppies and slaw, with the Heron Creek Pickers on the porch stage. Kids eat free.

name: Lantern Festival on the Water
summary: Decorate a paper lantern, write a wish on it and float it out at dusk.
description: Decorate a paper lantern, write a wish on it and float it out at dusk. Food trucks and taiko drummers line the beach.

name: Retro Sea Monster Arcade Tournament
summary: Bracket play on a cabinet game about giant squid.
description: Bracket play on a cabinet game about giant squid. Unlimited free play on the rest of the floor with entry.

name: Stargazing at Lighthouse Point
summary: The Saltlight Astronomy Club sets up telescopes on the darkest lawn in town.
description: The Saltlight Astronomy Club sets up telescopes on the darkest lawn in town. Saturn is up this week.

name: Sustainable Seafood Cooking Class
summary: Cook three dishes from overlooked, sustainable species.
description: Cook three dishes from overlooked, sustainable species. Includes dinner and a guide to buying fish responsibly at the market.

name: Saltlight Maritime Museum
summary: Three floors of shipwreck salvage, ship models and a walk-through whaling boat.
description: Three floors of shipwreck salvage, ship models and a walk-through whaling boat. The top floor looks out over the whole harbor.

name: Oracle of the Deep Aquarium
summary: A glowing deep-sea aquarium with anglerfish, giant isopods and a jellyfish room lit by an ML model that reacts to the crowd.
description: A glowing deep-sea aquarium with anglerfish, giant isopods and a jellyfish room lit by an ML model that reacts to the crowd.

name: The Lighthouse Laboratory
summary: A hands-on science center in a converted keeper's house: AR tide tables, a VR submarine and a room of optical illusions under the lamp.
description: A hands-on science center in a converted keeper's house: AR tide tables, a VR submarine and a room of optical illusions under the lamp.

name: Driftglass Gallery
summary: Sea-glass mosaics and coastal photography by local artists.
description: Sea-glass mosaics and coastal photography by local artists. The back room shows a rotating digital-art installation.

name: Barnacle Street Mural Alley
summary: A two-block alley of murals: a kraken wrapped around a fire escape, a school of mackerel made of circuit traces, and the famous lighthouse keeper cat.
description: A two-block alley of murals: a kraken wrapped around a fire escape, a school of mackerel made of circuit traces, and the famous lighthouse keeper cat.

name: Old Saltlight Lighthouse
summary: Climb 217 steps to the lantern room of the 1871 lighthouse for a 360-degree view of the coast.
description: Climb 217 steps to the lantern room of the 1871 lighthouse for a 360-degree view of the coast. The town's namesake.

name: Gull's Perch Overlook
summary: A cliffside platform with the best sunset view in Saltlight.
description: A cliffside platform with the best sunset view in Saltlight. Coin-op binoculars point at the seal rocks.

name: Tidewater Botanical Gardens
summary: Salt-tolerant gardens, a seaweed greenhouse and a koi pond bridge.
description: Salt-tolerant gardens, a seaweed greenhouse and a koi pond bridge. The flower terraces are in full bloom this month.

name: Anchor Park
summary: The town green, built around a rusted 4-ton anchor.
description: The town green, built around a rusted 4-ton anchor. Picnic lawns, a splash pad, and a Saturday frisbee crowd.

name: Kelp Hollow Dog Beach
summary: Off-leash sand for pups, with a rinse station and a snack shack that sells dog ice cream.
description: Off-leash sand for pups, with a rinse station and a snack shack that sells dog ice cream.

name: Tidepool Discovery Beach
summary: Rocky shore with signposted tidepools and a volunteer docent station on weekends.
description: Rocky shore with signposted tidepools and a volunteer docent station on weekends. Check the tide chart before you go.

name: Marina Community Garden
summary: A volunteer-run garden that grows produce for the harbor food pantry.
description: A volunteer-run garden that grows produce for the harbor food pantry. Drop in to help weed or just sit among the tomatoes.

name: The Rusty Anchor
summary: A dockside pub older than the lighthouse lens.
description: A dockside pub older than the lighthouse lens. Rope-wrapped stools, a shanty on Sundays, and the best fish and chips in town.

name: Driftwood Coffee Roasters
summary: Small-batch roaster with long communal tables and fast Wi-Fi.
description: Small-batch roaster with long communal tables and fast Wi-Fi. Order the sea-salt honey latte.

name: Bytes and Brine Cyber Cafe
summary: Coffee, bubble tea and 300 board games, with gaming PCs in the back.
description: Coffee, bubble tea and 300 board games, with gaming PCs in the back. Popular with students on hack weekends.

name: Low Tide Taqueria
summary: Baja fish tacos out of a converted shipping container.
description: Baja fish tacos out of a converted shipping container. Open late, cash-friendly, lines move fast.

name: The Captain's Table
summary: Saltlight's fine-dining room, with white tablecloths, a harbor view and a menu written each morning from the dayboat catch.
description: Saltlight's fine-dining room, with white tablecloths, a harbor view and a menu written each morning from the dayboat catch.

name: Pho Real Noodle House
summary: Steaming bowls of seafood pho and crispy imperial rolls.
description: Steaming bowls of seafood pho and crispy imperial rolls. The brisket is also great if you're off fish.

name: Sweet Seaweed Vegan Kitchen
summary: Plant-based comfort food: kelp 'crab' cakes, jackfruit po'boys and a miso caramel sundae.
description: Plant-based comfort food: kelp 'crab' cakes, jackfruit po'boys and a miso caramel sundae.

name: Mermaid Scoops
summary: Beachfront ice cream with flavors like salted caramel tide, ube wave and lighthouse lemon.
description: Beachfront ice cream with flavors like salted caramel tide, ube wave and lighthouse lemon.

name: Salt and Smoke BBQ Shack
summary: Smoked brisket and blackened shrimp at picnic tables on the marsh.
description: Smoked brisket and blackened shrimp at picnic tables on the marsh. Sells out by 7 most nights.

name: Brine and Bivalve Oyster Bar
summary: Eight kinds of local oysters on crushed ice, with half-price dozens from 3 to 5.
description: Eight kinds of local oysters on crushed ice, with half-price dozens from 3 to 5.

name: The Crow's Nest Rooftop
summary: Cocktails five stories above the marina with heat lamps and string lights.
description: Cocktails five stories above the marina with heat lamps and string lights. Hosts comedy on Saturdays.

name: Siren Song Lounge
summary: A speakeasy behind a fake fishmonger's freezer door.
description: A speakeasy behind a fake fishmonger's freezer door. Velvet booths, live piano on weekends.

name: The Deep End
summary: A basement club with a ceiling of shifting blue light that makes the room feel underwater.
description: A basement club with a ceiling of shifting blue light that makes the room feel underwater.

name: Fish Box Karaoke
summary: Private karaoke rooms built from old fish-market cold boxes, plus a main stage on weekends.
description: Private karaoke rooms built from old fish-market cold boxes, plus a main stage on weekends.

name: Shipwreck Escape Rooms
summary: Four rooms, from a sinking submarine to a lighthouse keeper's riddle.
description: Four rooms, from a sinking submarine to a lighthouse keeper's riddle. The 'Oracle' room uses a real voice assistant as the puzzle master.

name: Kraken Climbing Gym
summary: Bouldering walls shaped like the hull of a ship, with a 15-meter lead wall up the old crane tower.
description: Bouldering walls shaped like the hull of a ship, with a 15-meter lead wall up the old crane tower. Shoe rental included.

name: Pixel Pier Arcade
summary: Retro cabinets, rhythm games and skee-ball on a converted pier warehouse.
description: Retro cabinets, rhythm games and skee-ball on a converted pier warehouse. Free-play Tuesdays.

name: Starboard Lanes
summary: Sixteen lanes of glow-bowling with nautical flags overhead and a surprisingly good crab-fry basket.
description: Sixteen lanes of glow-bowling with nautical flags overhead and a surprisingly good crab-fry basket.

name: Harbor Kayak and SUP
summary: Rent a kayak or paddleboard by the hour and explore the calm marsh channels.
description: Rent a kayak or paddleboard by the hour and explore the calm marsh channels. Quick lesson included for first-timers.

name: Lanternfall Cinema
summary: A restored 1930s movie palace with a porthole-lined lobby.
description: A restored 1930s movie palace with a porthole-lined lobby. Mixes new releases with ocean-themed cult classics.

name: Seaside Market Hall
summary: The permanent market under a steel-and-glass roof: fishmongers, flower stalls, spice vendors and forty lunch counters.
description: The permanent market under a steel-and-glass roof: fishmongers, flower stalls, spice vendors and forty lunch counters.

name: The Shipyard Makerspace
summary: A community workshop in an old boat shed with 3D printers, CNC, electronics benches and a day pass for visitors.
description: A community workshop in an old boat shed with 3D printers, CNC, electronics benches and a day pass for visitors.

name: Compass Rose Books and Maps
summary: A creaky bookshop full of sea stories, old charts and a reading nook in a real ship's bow.
description: A creaky bookshop full of sea stories, old charts and a reading nook in a real ship's bow.

name: Salvage and Sons Vintage
summary: Brass portholes, fishermen's sweaters, vintage radios and a bin of mystery keys.
description: Brass portholes, fishermen's sweaters, vintage radios and a bin of mystery keys.

name: Circuit Cove Electronics
summary: Parts store for hardware hackers: sensors, microcontrollers, waterproof enclosures and staff who will debug your wiring.
description: Parts store for hardware hackers: sensors, microcontrollers, waterproof enclosures and staff who will debug your wiring.

name: Harbor Ferry Loop
summary: A 50-minute ferry loop past the lighthouse, seal rocks and the shipyard cranes.
description: A 50-minute ferry loop past the lighthouse, seal rocks and the shipyard cranes. Hop on at the marina.

name: Lighthouse Ghost Walk
summary: A lantern-lit walk through Saltlight's old quarter and its shipwreck legends, ending at the lighthouse gate at midnight's bell.
description: A lantern-lit walk through Saltlight's old quarter and its shipwreck legends, ending at the lighthouse gate at midnight's bell.

name: Sunken Garden Bathhouse
summary: Saltwater soaking pools, a cedar sauna and cold plunges carved into the cliff.
description: Saltwater soaking pools, a cedar sauna and cold plunges carved into the cliff. Ninety-minute sessions.

name: Lighthouse Point Loop
summary: An easy loop around the headland with the lighthouse always in view.
description: An easy loop around the headland with the lighthouse always in view. Benches at every overlook.

name: Oracle Bluffs Ridge Trail
summary: A steady climb along exposed sea cliffs to the Oracle, a rock arch that whistles in the wind.
description: A steady climb along exposed sea cliffs to the Oracle, a rock arch that whistles in the wind.

name: Kelp Hollow Marsh Boardwalk
summary: A flat, stroller-friendly boardwalk over the salt marsh with herons, fiddler crabs and interpretive signs.
description: A flat, stroller-friendly boardwalk over the salt marsh with herons, fiddler crabs and interpretive signs.

name: Shipwreck Cove Coastal Trail
summary: Follows the shoreline to the ribs of the schooner Marigold, visible at low tide.
description: Follows the shoreline to the ribs of the schooner Marigold, visible at low tide.

name: Tidewater Dunes Trail
summary: Sandy trail over rolling dunes with sea oats and a hidden beach at the far end.
description: Sandy trail over rolling dunes with sea oats and a hidden beach at the far end.

name: Mariner's Summit Trail
summary: The hardest climb in the county, up to a fire lookout with a view of three lighthouses on a clear day.
description: The hardest climb in the county, up to a fire lookout with a view of three lighthouses on a clear day.

name: Heron Creek Greenway
summary: A paved multi-use path along the creek, popular with runners, cyclists and families on scooters.
description: A paved multi-use path along the creek, popular with runners, cyclists and families on scooters.

name: Lantern Falls Trail
summary: A shaded forest loop to a 20-meter waterfall that glows orange at sunset.
description: A shaded forest loop to a 20-meter waterfall that glows orange at sunset.

name: Old Rail Causeway
summary: A flat gravel trail on a former rail line across the bay, with water on both sides.
description: A flat gravel trail on a former rail line across the bay, with water on both sides.

name: Sea Cliff Staircase Challenge
summary: 672 wooden steps straight up the cliff.
description: 672 wooden steps straight up the cliff. Locals time their laps; the record is on a plaque at the top.

name: Driftwood Forest Loop
summary: A loop through a bone-white forest of sun-bleached driftwood trees.
description: A loop through a bone-white forest of sun-bleached driftwood trees. Very photogenic.

name: Pelican Island Tide Walk
summary: Only walkable two hours either side of low tide: a sandbar crossing to a pelican rookery.
description: Only walkable two hours either side of low tide: a sandbar crossing to a pelican rookery.

name: Coral Ridge Sunrise Trail
summary: Start in the dark with a headlamp and reach the ridge as the sun comes up out of the ocean.
description: Start in the dark with a headlamp and reach the ridge as the sun comes up out of the ocean.

name: Saltmarsh Birding Loop
summary: A quiet loop with two bird blinds.
description: A quiet loop with two bird blinds. Over 200 species logged, including roseate spoonbills.

name: Kraken's Spine Traverse
summary: An all-day ridgeline scramble over nine rocky knobs.
description: An all-day ridgeline scramble over nine rocky knobs. Pack plenty of water; there's no shade.
